title: Padded clone payoff
statement: Let $E$ be a weighted constraint experiment with uniform refinement $R$, and let $r,M$ be natural numbers. Suppose every outcome of $E$ has predicate arity at most $r$. For an assignment of values to pairs of a variable and a clone index, the padded clone payoff at a sample is the payoff of its sampled outcome, using the clone indices assigned to the positions of that outcome.
